rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose expression for a rapid increase or sharp rise.

example.english: The proliferation of online shops has made the market much more competitive.
example.traditional: 近年網上商店數目激增，令個市場競爭大咗好多。
example.jyutping: gan6 nin4 mong5 soeng6 soeng1 dim3 sou3 muk6 gik1 zang1 ling6 go3 si5 coeng4 ging6 zang1 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for weapons spreading to countries that did not originally develop them.

example.english: The international community is working to prevent the proliferation of nuclear weapons.
example.traditional: 國際社會正努力遏止核武器擴散。
example.jyutping: gwok3 zai3 se5 wui2 zeng3 nou5 lik6 aat3 zi2 hat6 mou5 hei3 kwong3 saan3
